title: In silico docking yields small molecule negative allosteric modulators targeting the core of Frizzled 7.
authors: Scharf, Magdalena M; Kinsolving, Julia; Gratz, Lukas; Voss, Jan Hendrik; Carrasco-Busturia, David; Forsberg, Bjorn; Kolb, Peter; Schulte, Gunnar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟靶向Frizzled 7受体的小分子变构调节剂，属于蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Targeting the Frizzled family (FZD(1-10)) of WNT receptors pharmacologically has, despite substantial therapeutic potential, proven difficult. Given an almost complete lack of validated, effective small molecules targeting FZDs, no putative ligand binding site has so far been identified. In order to target FZD(7), a potential target for the treatment of intestinal tumors, we combine an approach of adapted docking setups and large molecular library docking screens, identifying compound C407. Applying pharmacological assays, genetically-encoded biosensors, site-directed mutagenesis, cryo-electron microscopy and molecular dynamics simulations, the compound binding site in the core of the seven transmembrane bundle is validated and C407 is confirmed as a negative allosteric modulator of WNT-induced and FZD-mediated WNT/beta-catenin signaling. In summary, we provide here the proof-of-principle that targeting FZDs with small molecule compounds is possible and effective. Future hit optimization and functional validation in disease-relevant in vitro and in vivo models will pave the way towards clinical exploration.
abstract_zh: 针对WNT受体Frizzled家族（FZD(1-10)）进行药理学靶向，尽管具有巨大的治疗潜力，但已被证明是困难的。鉴于几乎完全缺乏经过验证的、有效的靶向FZD的小分子，迄今尚未识别出任何推定的配体结合位点。为了靶向FZD(7)——一个治疗肠道肿瘤的潜在靶点，我们结合了适应性对接设置和大规模分子文库对接筛选的方法，鉴定出化合物C407。通过应用药理学测定、基因编码生物传感器、定点突变、冷冻电子显微镜和分子动力学模拟，验证了该化合物在七次跨膜束核心的结合位点，并确认C407为WNT诱导和FZD介导的WNT/β-catenin信号传导的负向变构调节剂。总之，我们在此提供了小分子化合物靶向FZD可行且有效的原理验证。未来的命中优化以及在疾病相关的体外和体内模型中的功能验证，将为临床探索铺平道路。
